answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because river only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any pearl approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
